chestQualityWeights.unit: basis points CONDITIONAL on equipment/gem reward; order replacement roll happens first

userApproved.hud: new chest region to the right of existing chests, same left/right mouse behavior

orderQualityFromChest.basis: saved chest source difficulty; source captured on acquisition, not current difficulty when opened

userApproved.orderDropMode: replacement: roll the order chance first; a success awards only one order and skips equipment/gem/material reward
userApproved.incomeScope: entire three-chapter run total is150% of the corresponding3-3 run, not150% per battle/chapter

implementationAssumptions.difficultyStats: Apply Hard 150%, Hell 200% to same-level HP/Attack/Defense; avoid stacking the old damage multiplier again. Keep speed and behavior counts unless the user requests otherwise.
implementationAssumptions.huntHealth: Scale each selected monster at the corresponding 3-3 combat level and difficulty, then apply the hunt-only 150% HP multiplier to all phases.
implementationAssumptions.huntEconomy: Gold settles once after final Boss:3×source3-3 TravelGold (=150% of normal challenge Boss gold). Ordinary/elite experience is deferred: first-chapter selected path records the matching3-3 reference amounts; final payout is150% of that reference plus150% of normal Boss experience, per party role. Travel pays150% of the complete7-encounter3-3 cycle once at the end of21 encounters.
implementationAssumptions.travelConsumption: Reserve a matching order while a hunt is active; atomically consume on successful full-run settlement; release on failure/exit.
implementationAssumptions.legacyClear: Preserve existing cleared stages; once-only retroactive 3-3 grant needed so old saves can use the new feature.
implementationAssumptions.routeContinuity: Carry party/deck/relic run state between the three chapter segments, settle the hunt after the final boss.
